triples.subject: Agrafena Alexandrovna
triples.quote: Mitya’s position with Agrafena Alexandrovna had certainly improved, and that she had said that she loved him.

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch Karamazov
triples.quote: Mitya had tried to buy off Pan Mussyalovitch, and had offered him three thousand roubles to resign his claims

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch Karamazov
triples.quote: Pan Mussyalovitch spoke proudly and warmly, so that Mitya was roused at once and declared that he would not allow the “scoundrel” to speak like that in his presence!

triples.subject: Maximov
triples.quote: The old man at once confessed that he had done wrong, that he had borrowed “ten roubles in my poverty,” from Dmitri Fyodorovitch, and that he was ready to pay it back.

triples.subject: Pyotr Fomitch Kalganov
triples.quote: Kalganov, when called, came in reluctantly, frowning and ill-humored, and he spoke to the lawyers as though he had never met them before in his life

triples.subject: Examination of the witnesses
triples.quote: was the sum spent here, at Mokroe, by Mitya on the first occasion, a month before, three thousand or fifteen hundred?

triples.subject: Fyodor Pavlovitch
triples.quote: she had not loved him, but had won his heart as well as his old father’s “in my nasty spite,” that she had seen that Mitya was very jealous of Fyodor Pavlovitch

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch Karamazov
triples.quote: she had not loved him, but had won his heart as well as his old father’s “in my nasty spite,” that she had seen that Mitya was very jealous of Fyodor Pavlovitch

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch Karamazov
triples.quote: “Agrafena Alexandrovna!” Mitya got up from his chair, “have faith in God and in me. I am not guilty of my father’s murder!”

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch Karamazov
triples.quote: and that she had replied to that that he hadn’t stolen it, and that he must pay the money back next day.

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch Karamazov
triples.quote: had heard him tell several people that he had three thousand with him.

triples.subject: First carousal at Mokroe
triples.quote: three thousand roubles had certainly been spent on the first carousal at Mokroe

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch Karamazov
triples.quote: three thousand roubles had certainly been spent on the first carousal at Mokroe

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch Karamazov
triples.quote: and he wanted to do it at once, at once, regardless of all obstacles, with all the recklessness of the Karamazovs.
